participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the stalls, and the drum at the puppet booth.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Took the bone, and kept Sam between himself and Pope.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Bargained for a bolster and got the feathers thrown in.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Chose a whistle over a knife, and ate pig until Phillips took the bone.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

participation.context: Stood by Sam at the cutler's board, and minded the bolster at the grease-trough.
participation.name: Arthur Meeks

relations.note: sixpence, one thing, and the bone taken

relations.quote: Throw the feathers in with the ticking, master, and you have my silver.

story.body: Pope got the feathers thrown in with the bolster. Sam spent his sixpence on a whistle. Phillips took the bone. You ate with one hand on your purse.

relations.note: sixpence, one thing, and the bone taken

relations.quote: Throw the feathers in with the ticking, master, and you have my silver.

title: Ate pork at the fair while Sam chose a whistle

participation.context: Took the picture. His face is not in it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stood by the fire and took one picture of the pig, the booth and the hats.

title: Took one picture of the spit, the booth and the hats

participation.context: Spoke to Gilbert, and bought three gingerbread men, one with gilt.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stood through three shows of the crown knocked off and set on again.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Marked Kemp in the ring, and the back in the fourth hour.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Said nobody liked to ask Burbage as whom, and sent the gingerbread home to Alse.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Gave the arrest back in four voices.
participation.name: Arthur Meeks

participation.context: Danced for nothing in a ring of two hundred, and bowed.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Stood behind the points and hat-bands, and affected not to know any players.
participation.name: Gilbert Shakespeare

relations.note: behind a fair stall, affecting not to know him
relations.quote: I know no players in Smithfield while my master's ledger is open on the board.

story.body: Burbage stood through three shows of the wooden king. Arthur repeated the arrest in four voices. Kemp bowed from a ring of two hundred. Gilbert affected not to know you. You bought the gingerbread before you thought.

relations.note: behind a fair stall, affecting not to know him
relations.quote: I know no players in Smithfield while my master's ledger is open on the board.

title: Stood at the booth, passed Gilbert, and bought three gingerbread men
